![](https://c10.patreonusercontent.com/4/patreon-media/p/post/176194583/2203abdfdc9b4c8491d32177f3f58803/eyJhIjoxLCJwIjoxfQ%3D%3D/1.png?token-hash=ODSwwQGhFn33NG4wWHkxnlkOATuorDAhWDCuwofyJ3A%3D&token-time=1795564800)

Hi everyone!

I've been building a story mod called **Moosyteries: The Unseen**, and with so much dedicated put towards it I strongly believe it is now ready for a small group of playtesters before public release!

This mod is about a small black calf named **MooCalf😉** who shows up where no cow should be. He talks, he consults, he files receipts, and he has a mystery he'd rather not explain. You follow his cases through 5 chapters of story missions, with a final choice that leads to 3 different endings, 30 side stories, plus activities, rare encounters and riddles. A journal comes with various tabs showing your cases, contacts, collections, stickers, a shop and gifts that **MooCalf** hands to your Zoi.

**What we're looking for:**
\- Players who can spend a few sessions with it over the next few days
\- Reports on bugs, confusing steps, text that doesn't fit, unfair riddles, or anything that feels off
\- Honest opinions on the story and pacing, recommendations for the mod and more.

**You don't need to finish everything. Even one chapter of feedback helps!**
Please note: Joining this playtest is not just for this mod but possibly future mods as well!

Interested? Join my Discord here: [MooNation's Discord](https://discord.gg/DFVU62vg) **(invite active for only 7 days!)**
